disposition: Not cleared: intrinsic width repair works for DefaultRow/Display data but adds an incompatible Display bound to the generic composition adapter.

finding.issue: composition::steps now requires T: Display even when Steps uses a valid custom RowFn<T>. Previously accepted non-Display view data no longer compile. Rendering custom content does not require Display, and the new measure_with_items documentation forces custom rows to fit an unrelated Display representation, creating a second label contract.
finding.independent_reproduction: The exact same separate consumer with a non-Display Data model and .row(|item,row| row.label(item.0)) compiles/renders Archive objects on c040, then fails solely E0277 at composition::steps on17841.
finding.base_result: One public consumer passed,0 skipped; Nextest aaaf115f-ec63-4401-92e3-afc0fdb0f662.
finding.candidate_result: Compilation fails because Data does not implement Display; no candidate tests executed.

positive_checks.unchanged_original_probes: Copied original c040 tests into a separate reviewer-owned consumer, unchanged test bodies, dependency paths redirected only to the reviewer-owned exact source. All4 passed,0 skipped at17841.
coverage: Intrinsic row with long live metadata now remains visible at an adequately wide root.
Explicit absent metadata hides queued fallback, while default metadata remains visible.
Widths0 through64, empty data,105 ordinals and combining/wide Unicode remain bounded.
Metadata cell widths and three-digit ordinal lanes render correctly across all four profiles.

source_review: measure_with_items borrows items and metadata and uses shared terminal-cell width; it does not mutate StepsState, route input, draw or invoke the supplied StepState projection. It uses a worst-case fallback state-label width instead.
Legacy Steps::measure remains unchanged by this commit. The composition leaf delegates to the widget measure function and invokes the existing draw with the same borrowed component/state/data.

No second layout/input system or app-coordinate geometry is added. Metadata and Display callbacks remain caller code; their documented contract must require pure presentation projection during measurement.
git diff --check c040..17841 passed. No broad native/Clippy clearance is claimed after finding the public compile regression.
required_repair_plan: Preserve composition::steps generic support for non-Display custom rows; keep DefaultRow label formatting as a renderer-specific implementation detail.

Prefer an additive optional pure intrinsic measurement method on the existing RowFn contract, with a source-compatible default for existing custom implementations and an actual Display-based implementation only for DefaultRow. If an explicit measured-row wrapper is used instead, retain the prior generic adapter and provide a documented fallback/override without mandatory dummy Display.
Do not run RowUi painting or the StepState projection during measure. Do not require the app to mirror a rendered label in a fake Display implementation merely to compile.
Any shared RowFn change requires agreement and serialized ownership with the runtime/component author. Avoid a new generic measurement framework.

Add the unchanged public non-Display consumer as a compile/runtime regression. Include a custom rendered label that differs from Display and verify its documented measurement policy, alongside the original four probes.
limits: This is a bounded intrinsic width and public API review, not complete Steps style/interaction acceptance, Jackin adoption, Showcase reference approval or full CLI parity. No product source edits or helpers used.
